seoTitle: Check Keyword Rankings in Semrush with Position Tracking
metaDescription: Learn how to check your keyword rankings in Semrush using the Position Tracking tool, monitor changes over time, and compare against competitors.
intro: Knowing exactly where your pages rank for target keywords is essential for measuring SEO progress. This guide walks through Semrush's Position Tracking tool, showing how to check your own rankings, monitor changes over time, and see how competitors are performing for the same terms. It's built for anyone who wants clear visibility into their search rankings without digging through raw data manually.

steps.heading: Open the Position Tracking tool
steps.body: Log into Semrush and navigate to Position Tracking to start monitoring keyword rankings for your site.

steps.heading: Enter your domain and target keywords
steps.body: Add your website and the specific keywords you want to track so Semrush can pull ranking data for each one.

steps.heading: Analyze your ranking positions
steps.body: Review the current position of each keyword to see where your pages stand in search results.

steps.heading: Track changes over time
steps.body: Use the historical data in Position Tracking to see how your rankings move up or down after content or SEO changes.

steps.heading: Filter by country and device, and check competitors
steps.body: Narrow results by location and device type, and compare your positions against competitor domains targeting the same keywords.

faq.question: How often does Semrush update keyword rankings?
faq.answer: Position Tracking typically refreshes ranking data on a regular schedule, though exact frequency can depend on your plan and campaign settings.

faq.question: Can I track rankings for specific countries?
faq.answer: Yes, Position Tracking lets you filter and monitor rankings by country and device to get location-specific results.

faq.question: Can I see how my competitors rank for the same keywords?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool allows you to add competitor domains so you can compare their keyword positions against your own.

faq.question: Is Position Tracking different from the Keyword Overview tool?
faq.answer: Yes, Position Tracking monitors ongoing rank changes for keywords you choose, while Keyword Overview is more focused on keyword research and metrics.
